subject: possible to have labellerx and labellery in facet_grid?

messages.author: 6d91a9061453aa7b
messages.subject: possible to have labellerx and labellery in facet_grid?
parts:
For facet_grid, most of the time I have different requirements for
labelling my x and y facets. I was wondering if a feature to select a
labeller for each dimension separately was possible. One example of
when this comes in handy is when using label_parsed for expressions on
one facetting variable, but which can't be used on non-expressions on
others. For example:

a<-runif(8)
b<-runif(8)
c<-rep(c("group 83","group 19"),4)
d=rep(c("10^1","10^2"),each=4)
pp<-ggplot(dfr)+aes(x=a,y=b)+geom_point()
pp+facet_grid(d~c)
pp+facet_grid(d~c,labeller=label_parsed)

Faisal

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: possible to have labellerx and labellery in facet_grid?
parts:
At this point in time, you really need to write your own labeller
function and switch behaviours based on the name of the variable. I'm
not sure I want to add separate options for x and y, because then it
seems like you might actually want different labellers for different
variables in the same direction.

Hadley
